reason: A proper VAT e-invoice with our tax code plus VietQR payment solves the exact accounting headache I have with foreign card billing, and provider price at the published bank rate means no markup to justify. I'd test with the free credit, then top up once I see the invoice is real.
objection: Another hop in the request path adds latency and a single point of failure, and I still need a signed contract before finance lets me spend real money.
would_change_my_mind: If the first e-invoice came back invalid or there is no contract/SLA available, I'd stop.
